title: Reconstructing Ancient Hohokam Irrigation Systems in the Middle Gila River Valley, Arizona, United States of America
version: Case selection, canal development, methods and conclusions
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes; not a source copy.

passages.locator: Case selection, canal development, methods and conclusions
passages.note: The authors reconstruct Snaketown-area canal expansion using Woodson’s period chronology, describing a canal in 450–650 CE and enlargement during 750–850 CE. Hydraulic outcomes are model estimates based on assumptions, not observed ancient flows; coordination arrangements remain uncertain.
